authority: #K2-362 sec.2.5 hard precondition (P1 + P1b must PASS before the exam run)
window_outcome: STOPPED: the window's hard precondition cannot be satisfied - the exam A scenario family (translate the left cluster) has NO mechanically-legal non-trivial magnitude in +X. The heavy exam run was therefore NOT made (the ruling forbids it), and M3's scope expansion was NOT started.

F1_P1b_had_two_real_defects_both_fixed: absolute-zero requirement -> false rejection (the BASELINE placement already carries courtyards_overlap 2); fixed to BASELINE-RELATIVE
the probe ran only gen -> BLIND to courtyards_overlap, which only appears after the crtyd polish stage; fixed to run gen -> crtyd -> DRC
findings.F2_probe_is_clean: a 0.5 mm edit changes ONLY the four scenario refs (zero unexpected changes) => the probe does not perturb the rest of the placement
findings.F3_reading: even +X 0.5 mm creates a NEW clearance violation => the cluster is hemmed in by COPPER (not just pads) on the +X side, so no non-trivial translation in that direction is mechanically legal; the earlier pad-based bound (4.400 mm) was therefore not the binding constraint

consequence_for_the_ruling.the_precondition: P1 + P1b can only pass with a legal scenario; the translate-the-cluster family cannot deliver one in +X
options_needing_a_ruling: A) relax 'non-trivial' to a very small translation and test whether a sub-0.5 mm move is clearance-legal (C5 would still hold) - weakest form of 'a real re-placement'

B) re-pose the exam to a DIFFERENT family: fold the blocking neighbours (D2/C73/C86/J13 and/or the copper in the way) into the change - explicitly a DIFFERENT change order that must be named (the ruling already says silent scope expansion is forbidden)
C) re-pose the exam to move the cluster into a region that is copper-free (a 'lift and place' scenario rather than a translation)
D) the supervisor authors the target placement (the ruling said coordinates are ENG-autonomous, but every ENG-chosen translation is now shown mechanically illegal)

what_is_ready_for_the_next_window: the sweep evidence that the translation family is a dead end
